findings.title: Questioning becoming inherited restriction
findings.claim: The focus's direct request can be seen moving into an unauthorized rule-making process: a community asks, the requested distinctions become prohibitions against what was released as lawful, and the resulting categories are defended as inherited sufficiency before the community settles into denial.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier سَأَلَ in سألها is a direct asking/requesting act. The attributed 5:87 carriers for prohibition and divine release place that act against a permission boundary; the focus قَوْمٌ supplies the communal carrier, while 5:103's repeated denial, fabrication, and falsehood and 5:104's claimed sufficiency and fathers supply the independent production and inheritance triggers. Their contact changes the focus from a bare report of earlier questioning followed by denial into a bounded image of demand becoming fabricated norm and then inherited closure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive how the earlier group's questions matter in the pericope: the danger lies in turning sought distinctions into a social rule system that covers the permission already given.
findings.containment: The plain sequence remains a community's asking followed by becoming deniers. The arrow from questioning to the fabricated restrictions is an attributed contextual inference; 5:103-104 may also function as adjacent examples of denial without proving that questioning alone produced them. No independent lexicon gloss or facet is supplied for the unresolved contextual branches.

epistemic.reason: Every HFT coordinate and anchor is supplied and within the declared pericope, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and six contextual branches have no independent registry descriptor, so their role remains attributed rather than independently lexicalized.

findings.title: Covering through repair or denial
findings.claim: The focus's denial opens a counter-reading through the same covering field: 5:89 shows speech-created liability being covered through prescribed repair and ending in gratitude, while the focus group covers what its request disclosed through denial. Both directions remain attached to the focus's plain result.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers سألها and كَٰفِرِينَ supply a request followed by denial. The 5:89 occurrences of expiation and gratitude independently trigger the accepted expiation and unresolved gratitude branches; their contact makes covering a response with two directions, reparative in 5:89 and destructive in the focus. The 5:89 oath-binding occurrences give the request a speech-consequence comparison without changing the focus verb into expiation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the difference between covering a breach by repair and covering an answer by refusal, so كَٰفِرِينَ carries an accountable response rather than only a settled label.
findings.containment: The focus still says that the earlier people became deniers. The expiation branch belongs to the supplied 5:89 context and functions as a bounded counterpath; no lexical equivalence between the current participle and expiation, and no claim that repair occurs in 5:102, is made. The packet's live alternative is ordinary derivative polysemy without an intended counterpath.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 5:89 occurrences are exact and the branch identities for both focus covering facets are supplied, but the contextual HFT reader is legacy_unbound and one contextual branch remains unresolved, so the contrast is qualified.

findings.title: Pressing for disclosure and bearing its consequence
findings.claim: The focus can be read as the later stage of the warning immediately before it: repeated asking draws concealed matters into disclosure, may make the disclosure distressing, and leaves the same matter available to be denied. The request therefore intensifies the evidence relation that the group later refuses.
findings.mechanism: The 5:99 carriers for delivery and concealment establish a boundary between what is conveyed and what is hidden. The 5:101 asking occurrences trigger emergence and distress; the focus سألها returns that pressure through its direct object, and كَٰفِرِينَ carries the accountable denial after the disclosed matter. The repeated feminine object in سألها and بها keeps the asked-about matter as the contact point while context changes the reading from generic curiosity followed by disbelief to compelled disclosure followed by refusal.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the focus repeats the object through the question and the denial: what was drawn into view is the very matter against which denial is later enacted.
findings.containment: The focus remains a report of earlier asking and becoming deniers. The packet's inference that insistence increases evidentiary liability is qualified; 5:101 may also be a narrower warning about burdensome questions whose answers become distressing, without proving that disclosure itself mediates the later denial. The target morphology of context ayat is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The 5:99, 5:101, and 5:102 anchors and all HFT coordinates are supplied, but the source reader is legacy_unbound and the causal arrow from disclosure to denial remains an attributed inference.

findings.title: Questioning as drawing hidden matter out
findings.claim: The focus request may also evoke a material act of drawing something concealed into reach: 5:94 supplies testing, grasping, and hiddenness, 5:101 supplies emergence, and the focus denial supplies renewed covering after exposure. This is an analogy carried by the contact, alongside the ordinary meaning of asking.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier سألها is linked by the supplied focus branch to a gentle or hidden extraction image. The 5:94 testing, reaching, and hidden-domain occurrences independently supply contact with an object and drawing it within reach; 5:101's emergence supplies the endpoint. The focus كَٰفِرِينَ then carries the accepted covering facet, so the extraction image returns through the focus as a movement from hiddenness to exposure and back toward concealment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the physical pressure inside the warning: asking may pull a hidden matter into the hand or into view, after which denial covers what has been exposed.
findings.containment: This does not replace the plain meaning that a group asked about something and later became deniers. The packet explicitly treats the form-distant س ء ل to hidden-extraction relation as a material analogy, not as the lexical gloss of سألها; the status is exploratory and the exact context target morphology is unavailable.

epistemic.reason: The focus and context coordinates form a complete supplied trace with a focus return, but the reader is legacy_unbound and the form-distant branch is explicitly bounded by the packet as an exploratory analogy.

findings.title: The community's straight standing
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:6 gives the focus word قَوْمٌۭ a bounded straight-standing resonance: the community that asked and then denied can also be viewed as a collective whose direction and uprightness are at stake.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier قَوْمٌۭ is an exact q-w-m occurrence. The external 1:6 occurrence مُسْتَقِيمَ is a separate q-w-m carrier in the requested straight path; its root contact activates the focus branch for maintaining a straight, balanced, non-deviating line. The contact changes the group from a merely chronological collective into a community whose shared standing can be seen against a straight direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The added ayah makes the focus group's denial legible as a communal deviation in direction, while preserving the focus's ordinary reference to a group of earlier people.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory external overlay, not a whole-Fātiḥa theme and not a claim that قَوْمٌۭ lexically means a straight path. Only the individual 1:6 root contact is used; the external context supplies surface/root evidence but no target morphology or independent lexical analysis.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch descriptor and both exact root occurrences are supplied, but the explicit external context is a lean surface/root projection without a trust label or target morphology; the added contact is therefore kept exploratory.
